title: Canonical interfaces for the finite-field derived tensor comparison
statement: For a small site, constant-ring module sheaves and unbounded derived categories, define total tensor, pure generators, coefficient restriction, flat-term K-flat representatives, tensor presentations, canonical comparison isomorphisms, and HasDiagonalComparison. This is exactly the interface formerly housed in lem-pur-finite-field-derived-tensor-summand; all original names and signatures are unchanged. Total tensor factors through a shared generic constructor, definitionally equal to the original Mathlib functor, as checked by a private rfl theorem.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03EK and 06YU: the original comparison definitions. The ordinary tensor wrapper is definitionally the original curried tensor, checked by rfl. The canonical totalization model contains the functor and all bidegree inclusions. Its existence theorem is proved by the concrete Mathlib model, and model_eq fixes the entire chosen model by equality to that model. totalFunctor_eq_mathlib identifies the total functor with the original construction. No data is chosen from an unproved existence assertion.
